name: Mag Muirthemne

attributes.attribute: an Irish mythological site where the hero Cúchulainn was said to live
a plain south of contemporary Dundalk, called Dún Delgan in Irish
the great hero of Ulster linked to the plain of Mag Muirthemne
the town, called Dún Delgan, more commonly the site of Cúchulainn's fortress

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Mag Muirthemne was an Irish mythological site. The great hero of Ulster, Cúchulainn, was sometimes said to live on this plain, south of contemporary Dundalk. In Irish that town is called Dún Delgan. Dundalk is more commonly described as the site of Cúchulainn's fortress.

okr.objective: Document Mag Muirthemne as the Irish plain associated with Cúchulainn.
key_results: Record the location south of Dundalk.
Record the Irish name Dún Delgan.
